summary_markdown: A user was seeking the most current hostname for a powerful ClickHouse instance used for local job queries, noting that their documentation currently lists `clickhouse04.allunite.local`. Another participant suggested an alternative alias: `clicknorris.allunite.local`. The user confirmed if this new name was merely an alias for the existing host. Later, the user reported receiving a 503 error when accessing a specific authentication service URL related to Rundeck.
decisions: The current hostname/alias for the ClickHouse instance needs verification.
action_items: Someone needs to investigate and resolve the 503 error reported on the authentication service endpoint.
